method: Fresh independent read-only audit of the exact 25 assigned web test files, using the routing list only. Read AGENTS.md and applied the parent-specified current user gate of two clean full audit rounds; no full test suite was run. Before review, independently recomputed every one of the 1,901 frozen raw SHA-256 hashes, sorted the [relative path, mode & 0111, raw SHA-256] tuples, hashed JSON.stringify of the tuples, compared the exact path set, and called the exported snapshot() from scripts/snapshot.mjs. Repeated all those checks immediately before sealing; both canonical and independently computed digests equal the frozen digest. Read all actual assigned file bodies, including fixtures, mocks, deferred completions, assertions, test cleanup, and state ownership contracts; this was not a title, hash, or AST-only pass. The initial multi-file output omitted a small portion of prompts.test.tsx through tool truncation, so reread its ending from line 531 through EOF to cover that portion. Workflows and workspace-management were read in adjacent complete line chunks. Reviewed pending input locks, approval/consent binding, opaque identifiers, provider revisions and secret clearing, catalog recovery, realtime sequencing and cleanup, durable operation identity, retired/unknown receipts, bounded rendering, resource/resume generations, settings navigation, skill creation/import, stream reconciliation, terminal ownership, combined history, queue/goal draft ownership, worktree and Git previews, workspace writes/downloads/search/watch behavior. Cross-referenced the complete supporting production/configuration files listed in inspectedFiles except web/Workspace.tsx, where only lines 1-250 and 1021-1115 plus targeted owner/key searches were inspected for the actual download lifecycle. Confirmed vitest.config.ts restores mocks between tests, ruling out a suspected Storage.prototype spy leak. Investigated a concrete stale-download candidate using only ignored .work reproduction files, the pinned Node v24.22.1 runtime, real React components, mocked local APIs, and jsdom. The first isolated reproduction failed as expected for direct project A -> B -> A prop reuse. The expanded isolated component run had 2 passing controls (normal and one-way project change) and 4 failed cancellation expectations (direct project ABA, API replacement, disconnection, reconnect); those direct prop failures alone do not establish an in-product bug. The actual WorkspacePanel reproduction passed all 5 checks (normal download, project ABA, disconnection, reconnect, epoch change). Its useResource invalidation removes currentFile and unmounts the old download owner, while App retains the same Api instance during its session lifetime. Therefore the candidate was ruled out rather than reported as actionable. Reproduction evidence is saved under .work/r13-web-test-b-download-repro-result.json and .work/r13-web-test-b-download-integration-result.json. No assigned test file was skipped. No earlier checkout, Git history, prior audit report, or prior finding was consulted. No tracked source was edited, no remote operation or live credential was used. Existing assigned tests were reviewed rather than executed; only the narrow concrete-candidate reproductions were executed. Native runtime, real browser media/terminal behavior, live provider/network integration, and the full suite remain untested by this supplemental audit. Complete means the assigned 25-file source review is complete, not that those external integrations were exercised.
